title: An LLM-Orchestrated Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Verifying Diagnostic Signal Reachability in Electronic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.07040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diagnostic Signal Reachability (DSR) captures whether board-level health signals are observable by management controllers, including baseboard management controllers (BMCs), complex programmable logic devices (CPLDs), and other smart controllers. Verifying DSR is essential for field diagnosability in datacenter fleets, where one design is deployed at massive scale, yet it remains largely manual, since each signal is traced by hand across schematic sheets, renamed nets, series components, and monitoring devices. Large language models (LLMs) are attractive but unreliable at structural connectivity reasoning, where over-claiming can silently hide a rare coverage gap. We present NetFlow-DSR, a neuro-symbolic framework in which an LLM orchestrates the DSR pipeline and resolves device roles mainly from part-name families and library pin names, consulting specifications only for ambiguous parts. translated_title: 一种由大语言模型调度的神经符号框架，用于验证电子系统中的诊断信号可达性
translated_abstract: 诊断信号可达性（DSR）描述的是板级健康信号能否被管理控制器观测到，这些控制器包括基板管理控制器（BMC）、复杂可编程逻辑器件（CPLD）以及其他智能控制器。验证DSR对于数据中心机群的现场可诊断性至关重要，因为同一设计会被大规模部署，然而这项工作目前仍主要依赖人工，因为每个信号都需要在原理图页面、重命名的网络、串联组件和监控设备之间手工追踪。大语言模型（LLM）虽然很有吸引力，但在结构连接性推理方面并不可靠，过度宣称可能会悄悄掩盖罕见的覆盖缺口。我们提出了NetFlow-DSR，这是一个神经符号框架，其中LLM负责调度DSR流程，并主要根据器件名称族和库引脚名称来确定器件角色，仅对存在歧义的器件查阅规格说明书。引脚方向性则从设计库中读取。
tldr: 该论文提出NetFlow-DSR，一个由大语言模型调度并结合符号验证的神经符号框架，用于自动化验证电子系统中诊断信号的可达性，克服了传统人工逐信号追踪效率低下以及LLM在结构连接性推理上不可靠的问题。
